reserveReview.rationale: The current Hamilton Lane SCOPE strategy page displays Share Class Performance dated 31/07/2026 and states that valuations are calculated monthly by Hamilton Lane's valuation team and reviewed and approved by its valuation committee. The SEC Form D/A identifies Hamilton Lane SCOPE Securitize Tokenized Feeder, LP, while the December 2025 SCOPE PPM and Hamilton Lane's monthly report describe the underlying Luxembourg SCOPE fund and its NAV-based private-credit strategy. Together with the Securitize distribution page, these sources support representing HLSCOPE's reserve envelope as one 100% tokenized feeder LP interest. No underlying loan-level composition is asserted: the master-fund portfolio is risk context for that fund-interest slice, not additional HLSCOPE reserve slices. The July 31 page is the latest dated valuation disclosure located; it is manager-published and does not constitute an independent reserve audit.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: SEC Form D/A feeder identity; December 2025 SCOPE PPM and Hamilton Lane/Securitize structure disclosures; Hamilton Lane SCOPE strategy page showing monthly valuation/performance dated 2026-07-31
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No residual unknown exposure within the reserve composition: the entire reserve is the tokenized feeder LP interest. The underlying Main Fund loan-level weights and cash sleeve are look-through risk details, not reserve slices.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Main Fund assets are held under an AIFMD depositary appointment to Brown Brothers Harriman (Luxembourg) S.C.A. with safekeeping and cash-flow monitoring duties, supporting structural bankruptcy remoteness of the Luxembourg SICAV-RAIF from Securitize's tokenization stack. Private-credit loans that cannot be held in custody are subject to depositary ownership verification rather than traditional safekeeping. The Delaware feeder's custodian of Main Fund shares, feeder-level account segregation, and reuse/rehypothecation terms are not published in the reviewed public materials.
